market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Cautiously optimistic. Today's action was a stark contrast to the prior Monday's failed gap-up. "The reaction this Monday was a big stark contrast to the reaction we had last Monday." The indexes are attempting to emerge from a correction, but the NASDAQ has yet to break through the 50-day line, the downtrend, and the 26,000 level. Justin emphasized that the key now is follow-through and holding above key moving averages.

VIK.technical_action: Getting above $105.76 level. Held the 21-day and 10-week lines flawlessly despite oil spike. RS rating 95, Composite 90.
VIK.story: Cruise line leader. Showed tremendous relative strength by not breaking down when oil surged. Earnings growth is strong.

GE.technical_action: Broke out previously, gained 20%, then pulled back to the 50-day. Now clearing another resistance area. RS line near new highs.
GE.story: Aerospace giant. Benefiting from the post-breakup value unlock. Strong, stable earnings growth.

PSMT.technical_action: Pulled back to 50-day after a brief breakout to a new high. Bouncing, approaching the $200 round number and $199.84 pivot.
PSMT.story: Retail (Price Smart). Less exciting fundamentals (low double-digit growth), but chart held up well and is part of the "held up best" crop.

MAGS.technical_action: Clear move above the 50-day and 21-day lines. Low cleared the 21-day.
MAGS.story: Magnificent Seven ETF. Strong tailwind for the indexes as the trillion-dollar club recovers.

CIBR.technical_action: Strong bounce off the 50-day, approaching key resistance. Justin prefers it over HACK because its top holdings (CRWD, FTNT, PANW) have stronger charts than HACK's (AVGO, CSCO).
CIBR.story: Cybersecurity ETF. A relative strength leader in tech.

JETS.technical_action: Breakout that failed, went below the 50-day briefly, then recovered. Nice close off lows and back above the 50-day.
JETS.story: Airline ETF. Benefiting from falling oil prices. A tricky hold, but the recovery is constructive.

DRAM.technical_action: Bouncing but still down 37% from highs.
DRAM.story: Memory chip ETF. Former leader that has been clobbered; not yet in buyable shape.
